notes: Values are radial/normal clearance per side, in mm, applied per the
brief's rough starting values (PLA row matches them directly): press
PETG and ABS are widened from the PLA baseline based on known material
behavior (PETG: stickier/oozier, more prone to mating parts fusing if
too tight; ABS: higher shrinkage and warping tendency than PLA/PETG),
not from independently verified per-material measurements -- these are
reasoned starting estimates, not calibrated data. Phase 7's calibration
wizard is the intended mechanism for replacing these generic defaults
with values measured on a specific printer.
